title: Pair request
description: POST /v1/pair (D6). The secret comes from the pairing offer (device/pairing_offer) the Hub's admin screen shows as a QR code or a manual code; it is good once, for five minutes. Closed input.

secret.description: The 128-bit pairing secret as lowercase hex.

platform.description: The device/platform values that pair: windows_hub is only the Hub's own Device row.

device_name.description: Shown in the Hub's device list.

app_version.description: Shown in the Hub's device list beside the name.

one_line.description: Text the Hub shows as one line: no control characters, line or paragraph separators (U+2028, U+2029), or bidirectional formatting characters (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069).
